settings.text: We believe bikes make life better. From first rides to lifelong miles, we’re here to support your journey on two wheels.

settings.title: WHO WE ARE
settings.text:
Today, Mike’s Bikes is a growing family of bike shops with a singular purpose: to get more people on bikes. We operate 14 stores across Northern California, a thriving e-commerce business, and recently welcomed five like-minded shops in Colorado to our community.

Our team of more than 300 passionate riders is here to support you—whether you’re shopping for your first bike, dialing in your fit, booking service, or exploring where to ride next. Our goal is simple: make every experience, both in-store and on your bike, the best it can be.

settings.title: Our Mission
settings.text:
We are here to help people experience the world by bike, live a healthier lifestyle, and engage with their local cycling community. Our success as a business comes from our ability to help create a better retail experience for our customers.

We believe in meeting you there regardless of how you want to shop. So, in-store or online, we are working to provide a professional and informative experience rather than a buy-it-now button or simply a cash register.

settings.title: WHERE IT ALL BEGAN
settings.text: Mike's Bikes was founded in 1964 as one of Marin County's very first Schwinn shops. It is rumored that our store in San Rafael was home to some of the first mountain bikes in the country. Cycling has changed dramatically as the decades have rolled by, but Mike's Bikes has never wavered from our total dedication to the sport.

settings.title: Part of a bigger family
settings.text: Since 2021, Mike’s Bikes has been part of the Pon.Bike family. This allows us to support our growth while keeping our independent spirit and local roots at the center of everything we do. Being part of a global network means access to leading brands, new ideas, and world-class innovation, all brought directly to the communities we serve. Wherever you ride, we’re here to support your journey.
